## Checklist

- [ ] One change per pull request, aimed at the `develop` branch
- [ ] Core tests pass: `swift test --package-path Packages/TuckCore` and/or `dotnet test Windows/tests/Tuck.Core.Tests`
- [ ] New logic in TuckCore / Tuck.Core has tests
- [ ] UI changes follow [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/aswin099/tuck/blob/develop/DESIGN.md) and were checked in light and dark mode
- [ ] No network calls, analytics or accounts added
- [ ] Original work only, nothing copied from other apps (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/aswin099/tuck/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] No real clipboard contents, passwords or keys in code, tests or screenshots
